requirements: Write the Prisma models for Transmitter and Broadcast, with correct one-to-many relation sides.
The Broadcast.transmitterId foreign key is optional; its relation field must have matching nullability.
Use String @id @default(cuid()) primary keys and an Int measurement field.
Declared delete semantics must match foreign-key optionality: SetNull if optional, Restrict if required.
tasks.user_story: Manage Broadcast records linked to Transmitter in the radiostation service.

requirements: Implement Next.js GET /api/radiostation-broadcasts using db.broadcast.findMany.
Use searchParams 'q' as a case-insensitive title substring filter only when supplied.
Filter by optional transmitterId, order by title ascending, include transmitter.
Return { broadcasts: [...], total: number } with status 200; empty results return [] and 0.
tasks.user_story: Manage Broadcast records linked to Transmitter in the radiostation service.

requirements: Implement POST /api/radiostation-broadcasts; trim required title and validate airtimeMin as a finite integer.
Enforce 1 <= airtimeMin <= 360 with HTTP 400 on missing/invalid/out-of-range values.
Check Transmitter.id existence with findUnique; unknown parent returns HTTP 404, except null is allowed if FK optional.
Reject duplicate title within one Transmitter with HTTP 409. Create only after every check and return 201.

requirements: Implement canAdvanceBroadcast(current, next): boolean for exact transitions drafted→cleared and cleared→aired.
Every other transition is false, including unknown states, skips, reversals and unchanged states.
Use these exact domain-specific words; do not copy stage names from any illustrative demo.

requirements: Build a responsive React component listing Broadcast items from a provided data prop; no network call required.

Render title, airtimeMin and current workflow status, with an explicit no-results empty state.
Keyboard operation and a 320px mobile viewport must remain usable without horizontal overflow.
